attributes.residual: NO CHANGE RETAINED. Baseline re-derived live and unchanged at close: real 869, insns 575/576, opcode multiset 5t, fuzzy 95.6052%, frame 592. FOUR probes, all byte-NEUTRAL, all reverted: (1) frame pad `u8 unused[248]` moved from first to last among the outer locals; (2) pad retyped `f64 unused[31]` for the highest alignment class; (3) the late store respelled as the scaled-index form `((s16*)blob)[offsetof(AtreeDefinition, objectIndex) / sizeof(s16)]`, chosen because it builds a structurally different address tree and the same idiom is already byte-exact elsewhere in this TU; (4) a throwaway `*(volatile u8*)unused = 0` diagnostic to test whether liveness moves the pad. THE RESIDUAL IS TWO INDEPENDENT MECHANISMS, not one, and the prior record's single-cause story is corrected. (A) The surplus address web: `addi r27,r24,54` at 0x3a4 feeding only `sth r23,0(r27)` at 0x864, where the target forms nothing and emits `sth r24,54(r25)` at 0x860. Worth 1 instruction plus a 6th callee-saved register, hence `lmw r23,556(r1)` against the target's `lmw r24,560(r1)` - a 4-byte save-area skew, and no more. The ADDRESS-SPELLING axis is now CLOSED across four distinct spellings; only liveness/call-structure levers remain. (B) A whole-frame inversion that DOMINATES `real` and that the prior record misattributed to (A): both sides use exactly 240 distinct r1 slots, but the target occupies 304..560 with 296 dead bytes BELOW, while ours occupies 20..301 with ~254 dead bytes ABOVE. The `u8 unused[248]` pad equalized frame SIZE at 592 but sits at the wrong END, so roughly 237 of 240 stack displacements read as diff lines with correct opcode and register. Three probes prove no property of an outer-block local (declaration order, alignment, liveness) can move it below the inner-block temps, and a positive control - one call with 30 stack arguments - grew the bottom region and pushed every local up, identifying it as the OUTGOING-ARGUMENT AREA. NEXT WORKER: (B) is the larger and more tractable prize and it is a STRUCTURAL, not register, residual - hunt an unrecovered call passing a large aggregate BY VALUE (296 bytes implies roughly 288 bytes of stack arguments) rather than adding or reshaping any pad; the pad should be treated as size-only scaffolding that can never yield byte-exactness. Do not re-probe address spelling for (A).
